Project overview

Outcomes and activities

Project brief

Principal Investigator: Facilitation of Capacity-Building Workshops for Stakeholders under the GEF-5 UNIDO Project on Promoting Waste-to-Energy Applications in Agro-Industries in Tanzania

  • Successfully organized and facilitated capacity-building workshops for key stakeholders. Trained policymakers and regulatory institutions on Waste-to-Energy (WtE) frameworks and applications. Enhanced capacity of private sector actors and developers in WtE technologies for productive use. Engaged financial institutions to improve understanding of financing mechanisms for WtE projects. Strengthened multi-stakeholder collaboration in promoting WtE solutions in agro-industries. Contributed to increased awareness and adoption of WtE technologies in Tanzania
